articleTitle: Circuit Design and Filtering Method for fA Level Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: Aiming at the high accuracy measurement requirements of weak current signals, this paper proposes a circuit design scheme and software filter algorithm for fA level weak current measurement based on transimpedance measurement method. It focuses on the selection of key components, design of current-voltage conversion circuit, high-resolution AD conversion, noise identification and filtering, which realizes the high accuracy measurement of 2pA~200nA current. The test results indicate that the measurement resolution is up to 1 fA and the relative error is better than ± 1%.

articleTitle: Research on the Invisible Cutting Method of Silicon Carbide Using Femtosecond Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: A new method for cutting silicon carbide wafers using a femtosecond laser has been proposed after studying the mechanism of action. The superiority of this method was established through a comparison with traditional molecular laser cutting on a test bench. The cutting speed and laser peak power were adjusted to determine the best parameters for cutting silicon carbide wafers using femtosecond pulse laser. Using this method can effectively reduce production costs, improve crystal cutting efficiency and quality, and has potential applications in hard and brittle crystal cutting.

articleTitle: Design of a River Overflow Alarm System for the Evacuation of Vulnerable Populations in times of Huaycos
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: This research shows that the negative consequences of a natural disaster can be avoided. In this case we refer to the overflow of a river caused by a Huayco. The negative effects of this disaster manifest each year in different regions of Peru. For this reason, we present the design of an alert system for the approach of landslides and river overflows in high-risk populations. The investigation is made up of four fundamental parts; the first is the development of a river overflow sensor; the second is a system that transforms the signal emitted by the sensor into an audible alarm; the third is the design of a concrete infrastructure to locate the sensor outputs and finally, a system that transports energy to feed the circuits used and the electrical signal of the sensor. Likewise, calculations were made to be able to determine and take advantage of the use of transistors in the river overflow sensor to arrive at a correct commutation of this device and thus be able to be used as a water level sensor.

articleTitle: A Multi-machine Collaborative Weld Trajectory Planning Method Based on Finding the Best Initial Weld Position
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: In order to make each robot complete its own assigned tasks flexibly and effectively for multi-robot collaborative welding applications, this article proposes a multi-robot collaborative welding trajectory planning method based on finding the best initial welding position. Firstly, the kinematic relationship is analyzed for individual robots in multi-robot collaborative welding;secondly, the constraints are considered, and the optimization objective function is established by synthesizing the evaluation of the operability and the global joint change in the multi-robot collaborative welding system; finally, using the Harris hawk optimization algorithm combined with the optimization objective function and constraints, the initial welding position for the best comprehensive performance is solved in the simulation software and the corresponding trajectory is outputed. Furthermore, the inappropriate position is selected for reverse solution and the results show that when the welding task is completed at the best initial welding position, the trajectory of each robot is stable and the change of the whole joint is small, and all the constraints are met.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit Aging Test System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of aging test in traditional monolithic microwave integrated circuit production line, such as the annoying complex work, too much consumption of labor and material resources, etc., a new monolithic microwave integrated circuit aging test system with high price-performance ratio and more reliability has been designed. The main control system of the aging test system is developed based on the embedded system of Linux and is automatically controlled by ARM chip. The PC software can run on the ordinary computer, replacing the industrial computer equipment. Self-developed temperature control system replaces the expensive equipment of high and low temperature box. ARM chip is used to switch acquisition channels in real time, which improves the efficiency of power meter. The aging test system was designed with functions such as automatic check-up after boot-strap, parameter configurable, manual test mode, automatic test mode, data acquisition, data analysis, data storage and fault detection. After laboratory testing, the results of the system reach the expectations.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Evaluation of Low Frequency Power Phase Difference Based on Sampling Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: The measurement uncertainty of phase difference of low frequency power measured by sampling method is evaluated. The measurement principle of low frequency power phase difference is introduced, as the same as resistance divider, shunt and digital sampling system. The measurement data of resistance dividers, shunts and digital sampling system are reported at 10Hz~400Hz. According to measurement principle, the uncertainty factors are analyzed and the components of measurement uncertainty are evaluated and calculated the standard uncertainty of phase difference. The uncertainty of phase difference is 118.4μrad (k=2) when using 30V resistance divider and 5A shunt at 10Hz.

articleTitle: Time Frequency Synchronous Wayside Routing Scheme for Space Based Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: The space-based transmission network is the infrastructure of the space-ground integrated information network, and its time-frequency synchronization is the core foundation for supporting inter-satellite collaborative applications. In the space-based transmission network, when time-frequency transmission is carried out between satellite nodes, the network route plans a better path for data forwarding and communication. Based on open shortest path first protocol, this paper proposes a time-frequency synchronous wayside routing scheme for space-based transmission network. Based on the communication path of space-based network, time-frequency transmission network topology is established to plan the optimal path for time-frequency transmission. Simulation results show that this method can make time-frequency synchronization of space-based networks converge faster and reduce communication overhead by optimizing the algebraic connectivity of networks.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Study of a Novel MEMS Comb-drive Acoustic Emission Sensor with Squeezed-film Damping Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: The acoustic emission (AE) sensor technology has been widely used in many fields. However, the effect of the compression membrane damping on the sensing response of resonant-type sensors is one of the main issues in current technology. In this study, a novel design with fixed electrodes containing etched grooves is proposed to reduce the compression membrane damping and improve the response performance of the comb-shaped AE sensor micro-element. The effectiveness of the new design in reducing the compression membrane damping and improving the electro-acoustic conversion ability of the AE sensor has been validated by finite element analysis and multi-physics simulations. Additionally, the stability of the new structure has also been evaluated. In summary, the new design proposed in this study can improve the performance of the comb-shaped AE sensor and has been verified by simulations. This study provides new ideas and methods for the further development of AE sensor technology.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Water Flow Calibration Rig for Calibration and Measurement Capability (CMC) Claims
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: The National Metrology Laboratory of the Philippines (NMLPhil) has recently established a water flow calibration rig that operates on the static weighing flying-start-and-stop mode. It serves as the national primary standard of liquid flow rate and intends to calibrate liquid flow meters of flow rate between 2 L/min and 2000 L/min. However, its performance must be evaluated and validated before it can provide high accuracy calibration service and benefit the different industry sectors and secondary calibration laboratories. This paper presents techniques to evaluate the performance of the NMLPhil water flow calibration rig. First, the flow rate measurement process’s critical variables were investigated. Next, the sources of measurement uncertainties were analyzed and calculated using the Law of Propagation of Uncertainty (LPU) to realize the calibration rig’s achievable accuracy. The calibration uncertainty’s validity was investigated experimentally. Two flowmeters were calibrated simultaneously using the rig’s balances to determine the agreement between the obtained K-factors. Finally, the Calibration and Measurement Capability (CMC) was estimated based on the best measurement condition. The result of the experiment shows that it is practical and simpler to fix the collection time to 50 s, giving expanded uncertainty ranging from (0.054 to 0.090)% (k = 2). Therefore, the CMC of the water flow calibration rig was declared as 0.1 % with at least 50 s of collection time. Furthermore, the result shows that the deviation in K-factors was within the calculated uncertainty. Therefore, it confirms consistency in the calibration.

articleTitle: Research on Edge Clock Consistency Synchronization Method Based on Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: With the vigorous development of intelligent autonomous technology, clock network consistency synchronization method in the moving platform has increasingly become a research hotspot. In the highly dynamic and large-scale environment, the dynamic characteristics of terminal devices and the large relative motion speed bring great challenges to the high-precision consistent clock synchronization of the cluster clock network in the moving platform. This paper proposes a high-precision consistent synchronization method for edge clocks based on cloud-edge collaboration architecture, constructing a clock dynamic model and clock measurement model based on cloud-edge collaboration and edge-edge collaboration according to multi-intelligence consistency theory, and designing a distributed consistent synchronization algorithm for edge clock networks.

articleTitle: Distributed Dynamic Consensus Clock Synchronization Algorithm for High-precision Spatial Time-frequency Synchronization Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: With the reduction of satellite launch costs and the development of micro satellite technology, major space faring countries in the world have begun to vigorously develop large-scale LEO constellations. High-precision time-frequency synchronization network is the core foundation of large-scale LEO constellations. Compared with the structural clock synchronization method of traditional satellite networks, the consensus-based clock synchronization method is more suitable for distributed, highly dynamic, multi-node satellite networks. This paper proposes a dynamic compensation method for the unified modeling of satellite clock and inter satellite motion in a highly dynamic satellite environment. Combining the multi-agent consistency theory, a space virtual clock model is constructed to dynamically compensate the errors caused by relative motion between satellite nodes. Compared with no dynamic compensation, the clock synchronization result has been greatly improved, which can meet the requirements of high-precision time-frequency synchronization network for large-scale LEO constellation in the future.

articleTitle: Construction of an Integrated Practice System for Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering Based on Digital System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Measurement Instrumentation and Electronics (ICMIE)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing is a new production mode with the functions of self-perception, self-learning, self-decision, self-execution, and self-adaptation. How to highlight the technical characteristics in the practice of intelligent manufacturing engineering and to improve students’ understanding of intelligent products, production, and services is a problem to be solved. Therefore, an integrated practice system for intelligent manufacturing engineering based on digital system was constructed in this study. The practice content of intelligent manufacturing was divided into four modules, and each module was connected through a unified practice goal. Digital technology was used throughout the practice process, so that students can master the application of digital and information technical means in the manufacturing process. A complete practice process was given, and students’ abilities were evaluated on the basis of the competency model. The analysis results showed that teachers in the field of intelligent manufacturing gave a high evaluation to the students’ abilities, which proved the feasibility of the practice system. The practice system proposed in this paper has a good reference value for the establishment of similar engineering majors.
